name: PIPER METHYSTICUM
key_symptoms: Pain in right arm. Hands feel paralyzed. Pain in thumb-joint.
guiding_symptoms: Pain in right arm. Hands feel paralyzed. Pain in thumb-joint.

better: by turning mind to another topic

mind_symptoms: Very sensitive. Exaltation of mind. Amelioration of pains for a time by diverting attention. Restless desire to change position.
Urine.--Increased. Burning during micturition, gonorrhśa, and gleet. Cystitis. Chordee.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Pain in right arm. Hands feel paralyzed. Pain in thumb-joint.
skin_symptoms: Scaly. Fall of scales leaves white spots, which often ulcerate. Leprosy. Ichthyosis.
